messages:
Alex: Heads-up — NexaOps just confirmed a partial ship: 60/100 H100s available for shipment week of 2027-05-03, remainder earliest 2027-06-21. They flagged potential customs delay in FRA 5–10 days.
Carlos - NexaOps: Confirmed. Vendor policy requires a 20-unit DOA/RMA holdback. We can release 10 of those to you on an expedited lane (+12% unit surcharge) with 48h turnaround. AWBs will be separate for SFO/AMS split.
Maria: @Alex how many do we need to bring clusters back to baseline? We currently have 40 in spare pool + 12 in transit from earlier PO.
Alex: Baseline target is +80 to meet committed capacity for Q2. With 60 arriving and reassigning 10 from spares we get close (~92%), but that leaves <10 units buffer for RMAs — risky.
Jong: Recommend accepting 10 expedited units and request vendor split shipments across SFO + AMS depots so we can route by region and reduce cross-region warmup.
Carlos - NexaOps: We can split SFO/AMS, but it adds freight and insurance. Example provisional AWB lines:
```
AWB: 1234 5678901 - SFO - 30 H100
AWB: 1234 5678902 - AMS - 30 H100
```
OpsBot: Ticket RMA-2347 created for the 20-unit DOA holdback. Tracking portal: https://nexasupply.example/track/RMA-2347 (ETA checks attached).
Maria: Cost question: what's the expedite upcharge and split-depot delta?
Carlos - NexaOps: Expedite = +12% per unit. Split-depot routing = +6% freight. If you waive consolidated AWB (i.e., allow two AWBs) we can reduce brokerage by ~2%.
Alex: If expedite nets 10 units in 48h we should take it. Approve up to $330,000 additional spend for expedite + split routing, pending finance sign-off.
Maria: OK, I approve up to $330k for expedite + split routing, contingent on ASN and commercial invoice with HS codes. Finance will need invoice line items.
Jong: Logistics checklist: need ASN, commercial invoice w/ HS codes, serial manifest, and pre-alert to SFO to reserve dock space. I'll loop in our freight broker and customs broker.
Alex: Carlos, can you provide a provisional serial manifest now so we can reconcile allocations against our cluster manifests?
Carlos - NexaOps: Will upload tonight. Provisional serial range for the 60 units: `H100-AX-0001..0060` (placeholders). Final serials after QA and palletization.
Maria: Also request vendor to palletize RMA holdback separately and mark them DOA-hold on the AWB so depot teams can process returns faster.
Carlos - NexaOps: Noted — we'll request separate pallets and annotate AWB lines as DOA-HOLD.
Alex: If customs hold exceeds 72h we should escalate for demurrage credit; include that as a clause in the expedite purchase order. :thinking_face:
Jong: Agreed. I'll add demurrage tracking under ticket LOG-889 and capture PODs when units arrive.
Alex: Thanks all. Re-check manifest when uploaded and we'll confirm final split and routing.
